title: A table can be laid out at its narrowest width instead of as records
body:
When a table's columns do not fit the width even at the column floor, `render_with` draws it as records, one row per cell. coax pans a wide table instead, so it lays the table out at the floor total itself. Its `column_widths` in `src/ui.rs` renders the table at 1000 columns and splits the drawn `─┼─` rule to recover each column's natural width, and `table_width` repeats cmr's 3-column gap and its narrowing order. Both break without an error if cmr changes the rule glyph or the gap.

## Proposal

A table setting on `Format`, `.tables(Overflow::Keep)`, that lays a table that does not fit out at its narrowest width, with rows wider than `width`, as `Overflow::Keep` does for code. coax could then delete `column_widths` and `table_width`.

## Rejected

- `Block::column_widths(&self) -> Option<Vec<usize>>`. coax would still repeat the gap and the narrowing order.
